subject: Stone Ridge, and your next site
body:
Hi Marc,

I've been following Allaire Living's work. Stone Ridge in Port Moody is exactly the kind of townhome community we design.

Formwerks has been designing traditional wood-frame townhome and low-rise communities in Vancouver since 1988. Architecture, interiors and landscape are all done in-house.

If you have a project coming up, send us the address of a site you're looking at. Within two weeks we'll send back a short study of what it allows, how many homes fit and the likely approvals path.

I've attached a portfolio of our work below. Would you have 20 minutes for a coffee in the next few weeks?

subject: For whoever leads new projects at Konic Homes
body:
Hello,

Could you pass this to whoever leads acquisitions or new projects?

We're Formwerks, a Vancouver architecture firm. We've designed 2,500+ multi-family homes, mostly wood-frame townhomes and low-rise in a traditional style, with interiors and landscape in-house. Rose Garden in Richmond caught our eye because it's very close to work like our Vancouver multiplexes and boutique townhome projects.

If you have a site in the works, send us the address. Within two weeks we'll return a short study covering what the site allows, the yield and unit mix, and the approvals path.

I've also attached a portfolio of our work below.
note: No named contact, so this is the office-inbox version.
